title: mentha suaveolens var. reverchonii
intro: Mentha suaveolens var. reverchonii, commonly known as Woolly Mint, is a variant of the Mentha suaveolens plant, a species of flowering plant in the family Lamiaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its health benefits, which include relief from digestive issues, respiratory problems, and skin irritations due to its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Woolly Mint include its ability to soothe digestive upset, calm respiratory issues, and reduce skin inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include menthone, menthol, and limonene, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
